profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a nonprofit open-source foundation that develops and maintains Blender, a free and open-source 3D creation software suite. The software covers modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, camera and object tracking, and 2D drawing directly within a 3D viewport, and the site notes that VFX professionals have described its tracking tools as "probably the best tracker in the market." Blender is built on a flexible Python-controlled interface and supports community-developed add-ons through an accessible Python API. The foundation states that Blender is a member of ASWF, Khronos, Linux Foundation, and OIN, and that the software is supported by hardware vendors including AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks Blender AI Add-ons, described as third-party plugins that bring AI capabilities to the 3D creation workflow, operating with local processing and open-source licensing, with model provenance varying by individual plugin. Blender 5.2 LTS is highlighted on the site for a Cycles Texture Cache feature intended to improve memory efficiency when rendering scenes with many image textures, alongside new Grease Pencil texture brushes and an Online Essentials Asset Library. Blender Studio, the foundation's in-house production arm, has announced a feature film project called OVERGROWN and has published updated training materials including a new Animation Fundamentals chapter. No litigation, SEC filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
